name: Quarterly Performance
description: Aggregates sales by quarter for executive-level period-over-period comparison and seasonal planning.
sql:
SELECT
    Quarter,
    COUNT(*)                             AS "Orders",
    ROUND(SUM("Price (INR)"), 2)         AS "Revenue (INR)",
    ROUND(AVG("Price (INR)"), 2)         AS "Avg Order Value (INR)",
    ROUND(AVG(Rating), 3)                AS "Avg Rating"
FROM orders
GROUP BY Quarter
ORDER BY Quarter;
